violation_type.title: Prohibited Punishments - Hitting with Hand or Instrument (26 TAC §746.2805(4))
violation_type.short_title: Prohibited Punishments - Hitting with Hand or Instrument
violation_type.typical_finding: A caregiver used inappropriate discipline toward a child in care.

finding_variants.text: A caregiver used inappropriate discipline toward a child in care.
A teacher slapped a child who threw a toy at her. The teacher was terminated as a result of this action.

Based on the information obtained, there is sufficient evidence to suggest  that a caregiver administered prohibited discipline to a child in care.     As of completion of the investigation the employee was immediately terminated.
Caregiver was observed slapping a child's hand.
During an investigation it was found that a caregiver placed tape over a child's mouth for a few seconds. This was corrected when the tape was removed.
This standard was evaluated in regard to an investigation and a violation was found. It was found that a caregiver hit a child over her hand when the child hit another child.
